entries.title: Lotus Ferry
entries.body: A fishing village at the river's bend. Aunt Ping, Lu and a few dozen others. Home.

entries.title: The Hollowing
entries.body: A grey that drains colour, then life. Hollowed beasts have empty white eyes.

entries.title: Realms
entries.body: Mortal, Bone Forging, Qi Kindling, Qi Unfurling, Heart Tempering, Cloud Stride, Spirit Awakening, Heaven Glimpse... and beyond the valley, more.

entries.title: Body training
entries.body: Stumps and stones temper the body. Body Level supports every breakthrough.

entries.title: Training sects
entries.body: The Jade Sect Academy by the river and the Cloud Sect Monastery on the cliffs.

entries.title: Ranks
entries.body: Service, outer, inner, core and personal disciples.

entries.title: Weapons
entries.body: Gauntlets, jian, spear, short blade, staff and bow. Each has its Dao.

entries.title: Qi
entries.body: The river's breath, gathered inside you. Meditate to gather it; techniques spend it.

entries.title: Companions
entries.body: Fellow disciples who fight beside you.

entries.title: Dungeons
entries.body: Chains of rooms with a boss at the end and a chest for the brave.

entries.title: Heaven's Cleansing
entries.body: At Qi Kindling 9, heaven washes the body of impurity.

entries.title: Hollowed beasts
entries.body: Grey versions of valley animals. They spread the Hollowing with every hit.

entries.title: Yan Heng
entries.body: A figure in the light of the Cleansing. A man with a river in his eyes.

entries.title: Lu's past
entries.body: Lu's handwriting on a shrine drowned a hundred years ago.

entries.title: The Riverbreath inheritance
entries.body: Lu hid his method's full form at the bottom of the Scripture Well, for whoever could breathe with the river.

entries.title: The Heart Trial
entries.body: A mirror. What comes out is you.

entries.title: Flight
entries.body: At Cloud Stride, Qi carries the body.

entries.title: The Azure Expanse
entries.body: Beyond the Ascension Gate: a larger world.

entries.title: Beyond the Gate
entries.body: You passed the Gate Guardian. The river keeps flowing.

entries.title: Cloudgate Port
entries.body: A harbour on a floating island where the Ascension Gate opens onto the Azure Expanse. Sky-ships, toll wardens and every kind of traveller.

entries.title: The Nine Peaks Alliance
entries.body: Nine sects on nine peaks, one law between them. They keep the sky roads safe and tax every step taken on them.

entries.title: Storm Ward
entries.body: The Expanse's storms draw Qi out of anyone not attuned to them. Four jades, fed with Storm Shards, ward the blood. Each region asks for more.

entries.title: The Grey Pilgrim
entries.body: A robed stranger buying Hollow shards across the Expanse. He casts no shadow, and he knew your name.

entries.title: The Hermit of Rimefrost
entries.body: Hermit Shuang has sat above the snow line so long the ice grows around him. He speaks when silence has earned it.

entries.title: Lu's crossing
entries.body: The lake's mirror showed a young Lu at Mirrorwater, long ago, a river token at his belt. He came through the Expanse once, too.

entries.title: The Nine Seats
entries.body: Nine sects, nine seats in the Hall of Nine. Every cultivator who crosses the gate is asked to take the Alliance's token or keep the free road.

entries.title: The Gale Canyons
entries.body: Wind-carved sandstone east of Nine Peaks. Kites that are not kites, harpies in the roosts, and a toll paid in Hollow shards.

entries.title: The Ironroot clan
entries.body: A clan of the canyon's far side whose ancestors' tablets are carved from iron-hard roots. Kin by choice, not only by blood.

entries.title: Sage Qi
entries.body: True Qi pressed until it remembers it was light. Stronger by far, and the valley could never have held it.

entries.title: River of Time and Space
entries.body: Locked.

entries.title: The Jade River
entries.body: It runs through every land you will ever see.
